information: This competition is organized with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/). - [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.westcoastcubing.com) presents our 69th and final Bay Area Speedcubin' competition! Don't worry! There will be more cubing in the bay area, but we will be retiring the name. - *If we run ahead of schedule, we will wait until the proper time to start the next time slot.* - Competitors will be able to select their timeslots/groups and register for unofficial events [here](https://sixstringcal.github.io/BASC-69-Schedule/) before the event; however, we will be assigning timeslots to competitors who don't pre-select their timeslots. These will be available on the competitor cards the day of as well as through [CompetitionGroups.com](https://www.competitiongroups.com/competitions/BayAreaSpeedcubin692026) approximately a week before the competition. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjAyNzQ2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--0c5a8c8cdf1f75a3df7eae5f73e61b1bf38d33e2/BASC69LogoCondensedDarkOutline.png) ### The Grand Finale: Celebrating 13 years of Bay Area Speedcubin' The 69th and final installment of Bay Area Speedcubin', featuring unofficial events, games, panels, and good ol'-fashioned speedcubin'!
